battle.name: 圖拉真的安息戰役
battle.brief: 公元115年,凱撒圖拉真接管安息戰線,自敘利亞越幼發拉底,打進兩河上游;二月間先鋒取安息邊城辛加拉,同年春天安息騎兵卻在卡帕多細亞的薩塔拉擊潰羅馬守將佩圖斯,迫其率約兩萬人投降,這是全役最大敗績。漢朝同時以秦弩守河西,西邊戰局亦由商旅傳入漢史。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰雙方是羅馬帝國與安息(帕提亞)帝國。安息王奧羅艾斯一世控制美索不達米亞、伊朗高原與亞美尼亞高原, 軍隊以帕提亞弓騎為主幹, 按部落聯盟編組, 由貴族各自領兵, 國王自為總帥; 重甲騎兵多為宮廷與貴族親兵, 弓手則由各屬部徵集, 攻城時另有安息工匠隨軍備器械。羅馬方面由皇帝哈德良主持大策, 公元114年冬凱撒圖拉真抵達安條克, 接過東線指揮權, 前線部隊抽自亞細亞、敘利亞、卡帕多細亞三個行省常備駐軍: 以軍團步兵為骨幹, 輔以攜投槍與方圓盾的步兵大隊、敘利亞弓手、卡帕多細亞騎兵大隊, 以及隨軍工兵與攻城機械隊。亞美尼亞王國與卡帕多細亞是羅馬的衛星國, 埃德薩與薩塔拉是羅馬在東方的兩個支點; 同一時期在西面擴張的還有大月氏(後來的貴霜)勢力, 漢朝則以敦煌為西端, 靠商旅與使者維持對西域的情報。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Roman Empire and the Parthian, or Anxi, Empire. King Osroes I of Parthia held Mesopotamia, the Iranian plateau and the Armenian highlands; his army was built around Parthian horse-archers and lancers, organised in tribal contingents led by their own nobles, with the king as supreme commander. The armoured heavy cavalry were largely the household and aristocratic retainers of the court, the bowmen were raised contingently from the subject tribes, and engineers with siege equipment travelled with the army. On the Roman side the grand strategy lay with the emperor Hadrian, but in the winter of 114 the Caesar Trajan reached Antioch and took over the eastern command. The field forces were drawn from the standing garrisons of the provinces of Asia, Syria and Cappadocia: legionary infantry in the core, auxiliary cohorts carrying the pilum with rectangular and round shields, Syrian archers, Cappadocian cavalry alae, and engineer detachments with the siege train. Armenia and Cappadocia were Roman client kingdoms, and Edessa and Satala were the two outposts on which Rome depended in the east. At the same time the Great Yuezhi, the people later known as the Kushans, were expanding in the west, while the Han held their western end at Dunhuang and kept track of the Western Regions through merchants and envoys.
people: 帶著這場戰役名字的人是馬庫斯·烏爾皮烏斯·圖拉真(公元53至117年)。他於111年受封凱撒, 112年起與哈德良共治, 114年冬親赴東線, 115年11月以浮橋渡幼發拉底, 12月攻入泰西封。皇帝哈德良(76至138年)主持大方向, 117年7月病逝, 圖拉真才正式即位。安息方面, 奧羅艾斯一世113年弒弟帕科羅斯奪位, 114年驅逐亞美尼亞的羅馬駐軍, 115年被自己的兒子刺殺; 弒父者阿爾達希爾二世(即奧羅艾斯二世)即位後與圖拉真議和, 118年羅軍撤退時復位。羅馬將領中, 卡帕多細亞總督盧基烏斯·普布利利烏斯·凱爾蘇斯於114年在亞美尼亞擊敗奧羅艾斯一世, 美索不達米亞總督蓋烏斯·尤利烏斯·科爾布羅在114至115年間襲擾安息腹地, 而115年敗於薩塔拉的卡帕多細亞總督盧基烏斯·凱撒嫩尼烏斯·佩圖斯, 是羅馬在全役中最為人記得的敗將; 安息一方的統帥則是斯帕達吉尼斯, 以騎兵佯退著稱。同期史家卡西烏斯·狄奧《羅馬史》第六十八卷是本戰役最完整的敘述, 比提尼亞總督小普林尼致圖拉真的書札則留下了前線消息的另一種來源。漢朝方面, 115年是漢安帝元初二年, 西域都護府已廢(最後一任都護鄭眾卒於106年), 涼州羌亂方熾, 護西域校尉要到123年才重設, 班勇的西域出征更在126至127年。
peopleEn: The man whose name the campaign carries is Marcus Ulpius Traianus, 53 to 117. He was named Caesar in 111, shared the rule with Hadrian from 112, and went to the eastern front himself in the winter of 114, crossing the Euphrates on pontoon bridges in November 115 and entering Ctesiphon in December. The emperor Hadrian, 76 to 138, set the general direction and died in July 117, when Trajan at last became sole ruler. On the Parthian side Osroes I had seized the throne in 113 by murdering his brother Pacorus, expelled the Roman garrison from Armenia in 114, and was killed by his own son in 115; the murderer, Ardashir II, also known as Osroes II, made terms with Trajan and was restored to his father's throne when the Romans withdrew in 118. Among the Roman commanders, Lucius Publilius Celsus, governor of Cappadocia, defeated Osroes in Armenia in 114, and Gaius Julius Corbulo, governor of Lower Mesopotamia, raided the Parthian interior between 114 and 115. The Roman governor defeated at Satala in 115, Lucius Caesennius Paetus, became the most notorious loser of the whole war, while the Parthian commander there was Spadagenus, celebrated for feigned retreats by cavalry. The contemporary historian Cassius Dio, whose Book 68 of the Roman History is the fullest account of the campaign, and the letters of Pliny the Younger, governor of Bithynia, who asked Trajan for news of the front, are the two principal Han and Roman-side records of what happened. In China, 115 was the second year of the Yuanshu era under Emperor An of Han; the Protectorate of the Western Regions had lapsed with the death of its last holder in 106, the Qiang rising in Liangzhou was at its height, the office of Protector General of the Western Regions was not created until 123, and Ban Yong's expedition into the Western Regions belongs to 126 and 127.
kits: 這張卡的兵器是秦弩, 公元115年的秦弩正是漢軍邊防的制式投射兵器。弩機把弦的張力儲存起來, 扣機即發, 射速遠勝拉弓, 所以守城的一方能靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。居延、敦煌出土的漢簡所見烽燧器物簿, 常見一具一具登記的弩, 配上數十支箭與弩藥; 公元73年竇固出塞即以強弩為前鋒, 打通西域的戰役, 前鋒就是弩手, 湖南長沙馬王堆出土的西漢弩機則顯示這種機括已相當成熟。弩的射程一般在一百五十步上下, 齊射能封鎖狹窄谷口, 弱點是重裝緩慢, 射程遠不及羅馬的投射機械。羅馬方面以鷹式輕弩(有效射程三百至六百公尺)與石弩(有效射程約四百公尺)壓制城頭, 攻城另備撞槌、攻城塔、雲梯與填壕土壘; 步兵裝備投槍、鴞盾、分段鎧與短劍。安息方面的裝備則為馬上的系統: 角筋木製的反曲複合弓, 射程約二百米上下, 配鐵頭長矛、雙刃劍與單刃彎刀, 護身用鱗甲與札甲, 重騎披甲上馬但尚無馬鐙, 弓騎的射速與機動都是全場最強。三套武器系統的分別很清楚: 秦弩買時間, 安息弓買機動, 羅馬機械買射程。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Chinese crossbow, and in 115 the crossbow was the standard missile of the Han frontier army. Its lock stored the strain of the drawn string and released it at the press of a trigger, so its rate of fire far exceeded that of the bow, which is why a defending garrison could use it to hold attackers outside the walls. The beacon-tower inventories recovered at Juyan and Dunhuang show crossbows entered by the piece, with arrows counted by the tens and with the fittings for the bolts; the expedition of Dou Gu in 73 CE drove into the basins of the Tarim with strong crossbows as its spearhead, and the crossbowmen were the spearhead of every Han campaign in the west, while the Han crossbow lock excavated at Mawangdui in Changsha shows how mature the mechanism already was. The range of a Han crossbow was on the order of one hundred and fifty paces, and a volley could seal a narrow defile; the weakness lay in the slow reload and in a reach far below that of Roman artillery. Rome answered the Parthian horse-archers with the carroballista, a light bolt-thrower of three to six hundred metres, and the onager, a stone-thrower effective to roughly four hundred metres, backed at sieges by rams, towers, ladders and earthen causeways; the infantry carried the pilum, the scutum, segmentata armour and the short sword. Parthian equipment belonged to the saddle: composite recurved bows of horn, sinew and wood with a range of about two hundred metres, iron-headed lances, one-edged swords and curved sabres, scale and lamellar armour, and armoured heavy cavalry who fought without the benefit of stirrups, the mounted archery itself the fastest of the three systems. The difference between the three is simple: the Chinese crossbow bought time, the Parthian bow bought mobility, and the Roman engines bought reach.
tactics: 薩塔拉的戰術是安息式的: 帕提亞騎兵先以佯退把羅馬騎兵拉出陣位, 再合圍營地, 羅軍營壘被隔斷, 給養很快見底, 談判又被視為投降的前奏, 最後以佩圖斯率殘部投降收場。圖拉真在美索不達米亞的作法不同, 軍隊以縱隊沿幼發拉底與底格里斯河推進, 舟隊護住糧秣, 每日宿營都挖壕立寨, 沿途靠驛站與河運補給, 攻城時以石弩壓住城頭, 再封住河道, 然後用圍城與工程慢慢磨。帕提亞的野戰原則是不與大軍硬拼: 遊騎襲擊側翼與糧道, 燒掉沿途田莊, 逼羅軍吃盡自帶口糧, 對拿不下的城就切斷水源, 埃德薩的羅軍守軍正是如此棄守城牆撤回。安息還用弓騎「射了就走」, 使羅軍的投射兵器失去目標。漢朝這邊, 秦弩的用法與其設計完全一致: 城頭與烽燧的弩手齊射, 把衝鋒的騎兵壓在牆外, 河西走廊的關隘與烽燧按「烽燧、驛馬、郡城」梯次配置, 敦煌是最西的節點。羅馬靠機械決定攻城節奏, 安息靠機動決定野戰節奏, 秦弩決定的是邊防節奏。
tacticsEn: At Satala the Parthians fought in their own fashion: the horse feigned flight, drew the Roman cavalry out of the line, and then closed around the camp; the Roman position was cut off, its supplies ran down quickly, the truce that was negotiated was treated by the Parthians as the prelude to surrender, and the affair ended with Paetus capitulating with the survivors of his command. Trajan's method in Mesopotamia was different. The column moved down the Euphrates and the Tigris, boats protected the food and the ammunition, every day's camp was a ditched and palisaded line, and depots and river transport carried the supply forward. At the walls, stone-throwers kept the defenders down while the works were closed and the river sealed, and the siege was then ground down by engineering and time. Parthian field method was the opposite of a set-piece assault: light horse struck the flanks and the supply line, the country by the road was burned off, the enemy was made to eat his own magazines, and a city that could not be taken had its water cut until the garrison left it, which is how the Roman holders of Edessa abandoned the walls and withdrew. The Parthian bowmen also shot and left, so that the Roman artillery had no target to answer. The Han used the crossbow exactly as its design prescribed: rows of crossbowmen on the wall or in a beacon tower fired volleys and held the charging horsemen outside the gate, and the strongpoints of the Hexi corridor were tied together in a ladder of beacon towers, relay stations and commandery cities, with Dunhuang as the westernmost node. Rome decided the pace of sieges with machinery, Parthia decided the pace of field battles with mobility, and the crossbow decided the pace of the Han border.
data: 能夠核實的數字並不多, 只能照有根據的部分寫。115年2月, 圖拉真的先鋒攻下通往底格里斯河的安息邊城辛加拉, 但羅軍無法從周邊取得糧食, 佔領維持不了多久便放棄。安息王奧羅艾斯一世於同年被其子刺殺, 王位繼承危機令安息在這一戰線上失去主帥。薩塔拉的羅軍是卡帕多細亞分遣隊, 骨幹為第十五阿波利納里亞軍團及若干輔兵大隊, 總兵力一般估在萬餘至一萬五千之間; 狄奧記載被俘者約兩萬人, 這個數字與守軍規模的估計並不合, 應視為傳統的概數。被俘者被安息方面當作戰利品發售, 羅馬朝廷其後曾以贖金贖回部分人。距離同樣可以計算: 薩塔拉距安條克直線約五百五十公里, 距幼發拉底下游薩摩薩塔渡口約三百公里, 因此115年的兩條羅馬戰線是兩支分開的部隊; 辛加拉至泰西封直線約六百八十公里, 沿底格里斯河與軍用道路更遠, 115年12月進城的羅軍要靠這一段供應養活。兵器方面, 漢弩射程一般在一百五十步上下, 羅馬鷹式輕弩三百至六百公尺, 石弩約四百公尺, 帕提亞反曲弓約二百米。漢朝方面, 115年為漢安帝元初二年, 西域都護府已廢, 護西域校尉123年才重設, 居延、敦煌漢簡所見烽燧器物簿中, 弩按具登記, 箭按數十支計算。
dataEn: The figures that can be attached to this year are few, and only those with a basis should be given. In the second month of 115 the leading troops of Trajan took Singara, the Parthian frontier city on the road to the Tigris, but the Romans could not provision it from the surrounding country and abandoned the place shortly afterwards. In the same year Osroes I of Parthia was killed by his son, and the succession crisis cost Parthia its commander on that front. The Roman force trapped at Satala was the Cappadocian detachment, in substance the Fifteenth Apollinaris with a number of auxiliary cohorts, generally estimated at between ten and fifteen thousand men; Cassius Dio records about twenty thousand prisoners, a figure that does not agree with the estimate of the field army and should be treated as a traditional round number rather than a count. The captives were put up for sale as spoil, and Rome later ransomed a part of them at a price. Distances can be measured: Satala lies about five hundred and fifty kilometres from Antioch in a straight line and about three hundred kilometres from the crossing of the Euphrates below Samosata, so the two Roman fronts of 115 were separate armies operating on different orders; from Singara to Ctesiphon is about six hundred and eighty kilometres as the crow flies and more along the Tigris and the military roads, and the Roman column that entered the city in December 115 had to be fed across that whole distance. As for the weapons, the Han crossbow had a range of about one hundred and fifty paces, the Roman carroballista three to six hundred metres, the onager about four hundred metres, and the Parthian recurved bow about two hundred metres. On the Han side, 115 was the second year of Yuanshu under Emperor An of Han, the Protectorate of the Western Regions was already gone, the office of Protector General was only created in 123, and in the beacon-tower inventories of Juyan and Dunhuang the crossbows are entered by the piece and the arrows by the tens.
cause: 羅馬與安息爭的是亞美尼亞與美索不達米亞這條弧線, 更是經安息通往印度與波斯灣的商路。安息113年弒弟奪位後, 新王與羅馬扶植的亞美尼亞王系正面衝突; 114年安息驅逐亞美尼亞的羅馬駐軍, 凱爾蘇斯在亞美尼亞擊敗安息軍, 這才把東方的軍團拉進來。圖拉真的目標是打通底格里斯河谷, 拿下泰西封與胡斯之口, 把羅馬的邊界推到裏海與印度洋之間, 迫使安息接受羅馬的條件。安息內部的王位危機(115年奧羅艾斯一世被自己兒子所殺)讓安息在正面失守, 給了圖拉真深入兩河的機會。115年開打的原因則是兩面同時爆發: 安息在卡帕多細亞的反攻造成薩塔拉的慘敗, 圖拉真本人則自敘利亞南下, 把戰爭推到底格里斯河。漢朝這邊的處境與之平行: 元初二年涼州羌亂正熾, 北匈奴壓境, 西域都護府已罷, 漢只能靠秦弩、烽燧與屯田守住河西與敦煌。漢對西方戰局所知有限, 《後漢書·西域傳》既記安息與大秦爭奪兩河, 也記大月氏之王遣兵二十萬橫越天山攻元孟城而為康居所敗, 可見漢代史家並不把西鄰視為安分。
causeEn: Rome and Parthia were arguing over the arc of Armenia and Mesopotamia, and over the trade roads that ran through Parthia towards India and the Persian Gulf. After Parthia changed hands by the murder of a brother in 113, the new king came into open collision with the Roman-backed dynasty in Armenia; in 114 he expelled the Roman garrison from Armenia, and Celsus beat a Parthian army in the Armenian highlands, and only then were the legions of the east drawn in. Trajan's object was to open the valley of the Tigris, to take Ctesiphon and Charax, to push the Roman frontier forward between the Caspian and the Indian Ocean, and to force Parthia to accept Roman terms. The succession crisis inside Parthia, in which Osroes I was killed by his own son in 115, weakened the defence and gave Trajan his opportunity to advance into the middle Euphrates. The immediate reasons for the fighting of 115 were twofold and on two separate fronts: the Parthian counter-offensive into Cappadocia that produced the disaster at Satala, and Trajan's own march south from Syria, which carried the war down to the Tigris. The Han position ran parallel to all this. In the second year of Yuanshu the Qiang rising in Liangzhou was burning, the Northern Xiongnu were pressing on the frontier, the Protectorate of the Western Regions had lapsed, and the Han could hold the Hexi corridor and Dunhuang with nothing but crossbows, beacon towers and garrison farms. What the Han knew of the western war they knew imperfectly: the Treatise on the Western Regions in the Book of the Later Han records the struggle between Anxi and Daqin over the two rivers, and also records a king of the Great Yuezhi who sent two hundred thousand men across the Tian Shan to attack Yuanmeng and was beaten by Kangju, which shows that Han historians did not regard the western neighbours as quiet.
impact: 短期看, 115至116年羅馬一度佔有美索不達米亞: 泰西封的宮殿被焚, 財貨被掠, 羅馬的鷹旗一度立在底格里斯河下游。116至117年安息弓騎把這份優勢拖成消耗戰, 117年起兩河各省接連生亂, 118年圖拉真放棄全部戰果退回幼發拉底, 奧羅艾斯二世重登王位。長期看, 兩河流域的爭奪從此成為羅馬世界與波斯世界之間的固定邊界, 三百年後薩珊王朝接替安息, 這條邊界又打了六百年, 從羅馬與薩珊的戰爭打到拜占庭的皇帝們。對中亞, 帕提亞的耗損讓大月氏(後來的貴霜)成為巴克特里亞與印度的強權, 而漢在塔里木盆地靠已崩解的都護府維持的影響力, 就被夾在羅馬、安息與貴霜三方之間: 123年漢設護西域校尉, 126至127年班勇出西域征北匈奴, 都在這個背景下進行。對兵器史, 這場戰役留下兩道痕: 羅馬在兩河大規模使用投射機械, 並開始把安息騎兵的做法吸收進行省軍; 安息則取得羅軍裝備與被俘者, 馬上的射術更為成熟。在東方, 秦弩守住了河西, 但同一件事是反過來講的: 靠弩兵與屯田建立起來的邊防, 在政治的遮蔽消失之後, 無法維持越過天山的存在。
impactEn: In the short term Rome held Mesopotamia between 115 and 116: the palace of Ctesiphon was burned, its treasure was taken, and the Roman eagle stood below the Tigris. Between 116 and 117 the Parthian horse-archers turned that advantage into a war of attrition, revolt broke out in the provinces along the rivers, and in 118 Trajan gave the whole of it back, retired to the Euphrates and restored Ardashir II to the throne. In the long term the struggle over the two rivers became a fixed frontier between the Roman and the Persian worlds; three centuries later the Sasanian dynasty replaced the Parthians and that same frontier fought on for six hundred years, from the wars of the Roman and Sasanian age to the emperors of Constantinople. In Central Asia the exhaustion of Parthia left the Great Yuezhi, the future Kushans, as the dominant power of Bactria and India, while the Han presence in the Tarim basin, which had rested on a protectorate that had just collapsed, was caught between Rome, Parthia and the Kushans: the office of Protector General of the Western Regions was created in 123 and Ban Yong campaigned against the Northern Xiongnu in 126 and 127 against that background. In the history of weapons the war left two marks. Rome used its artillery on a grand scale in Mesopotamia and began to absorb Parthian cavalry practice into the provincial army; Parthia acquired Roman equipment and Roman prisoners, whose mounted archery made the Parthian horse still more effective. In the east the crossbow held the Hexi corridor, and the same story reads in reverse: a frontier built on crossbowmen and garrison farms could not keep a Han presence across the Tian Shan alive once the political umbrella was gone.
result: 115年的結局是雙方各有所得。羅馬輸了薩塔拉, 一支羅軍在卡帕多細亞投降, 埃德薩的守軍也棄牆而走, 東方的衛星國一度暴露; 但圖拉真本人帶著軍隊過河, 辛加拉陷落, 底格里斯河谷被打通, 12月進了泰西封, 塞琉古王朝的舊都與其宮殿被付之一炬。116年羅軍在底格里斯下游與安息騎兵反覆爭奪, 從未真正控制這個國家; 117年哈德良去世, 圖拉真即位; 118年全軍退回幼發拉底, 奧羅艾斯二世復位, 羅馬花掉了人命與年頭, 什麼也沒有留下。這張卡的秦弩並不在薩塔拉, 也不在泰西封, 它在同一年的另一條防線上: 元初二年, 涼州的羌亂還在燒, 河西走廊的烽燧仍靠弩與箭守著, 弩手是一個再也養不起更多兵員的國家能攔住騎兵衝鋒的辦法。西邊的兩大強國用各自射程內的投射武器爭奪地盤, 東邊的漢軍用弩與牆守住河西, 三方的武器系統各守其位, 互不相通。
resultEn: The year 115 ended with each side able to claim something. Rome had lost Satala, where a Roman army capitulated, and had lost Edessa, whose Roman garrison abandoned the walls and withdrew, and the client kingdoms of the east lay exposed for a season. Against that, Trajan had crossed the river with the army in person, Singara had fallen, the valley of the Tigris was open, and in the twelfth month the Romans entered Ctesiphon and put the palace of the old Seleucid capital to the fire. In 116 they fought the Parthian horse back and forth below the Tigris without ever holding the country securely; in 117 Hadrian died and Trajan became emperor; in 118 the army withdrew across the Euphrates and Ardashir II was put back on his father's throne, so that Rome had spent its men and its years and kept nothing. The Chinese crossbow on this card was neither at Satala nor at Ctesiphon. It stood on the other front of the same year: in the second year of Yuanshu the Qiang rising was still burning in Liangzhou, the beacon towers of the western corridor were still held by crossbow and arrow, and the crossbowman was the one man who could stop a charge of horsemen in a state that could no longer afford many more. The two great powers in the west fought for ground with the missile weapons inside their own ranges, and in the east the Han held the Hexi corridor with the crossbow and the wall; the three systems of arms each held its own place and knew nothing of the others.
